short: Third wife of Henry VIII and mother of Edward VI.
full: Jane Seymour was Queen of England as the third wife of King Henry VIII from their marriage on 30 May 1536 until her death the next year. She died of postnatal complications less than two weeks after the birth of her only child, the future King Edward VI. She was the only wife of Henry to receive a queens funeral or to be buried beside him in St Georges Chapel, Windsor Castle.
